svg.aria-label: Commit Harness overview: the user corrects New York to Boston; the harness holds the first proposed call, replaces it with the corrected one, and runs it once after 0.9 seconds of quiet.
svg.text: Scored by Full-Duplex-Bench v3 on 100 real recordings: tool use (Pass@1), turn-taking, latency
Gemini 3.8 Live · the talker: hears the user, speaks, and proposes tool calls
Waits for 0.9 s of quiet (1.8 s after “um”, “wait”), at most 8 s · a newer call to the same tool replaces a held one · “never mind” withdraws it · no call runs twice
An illustration of the mechanism, not a benchmark recording. On the benchmark the harness changed what ran in 2 of 100 recordings:
Gemini 3.8 Live usually proposes a call only after the user has finished.
